description.value: An fMRI study examined BOLD responses to alcohol-related versus neutral words in alcohol-dependent young women and female light social drinkers, including group differences and associations between craving change and subcallosal BOLD response.

spans.text: This pilot fMRI study suggested that alcohol dependent participants showed greater BOLD response to alcohol-related words than controls did in limbic and left cortical regions.

value: We hypothesized that alcohol dependent young women would show larger blood oxygen level dependent (BOLD) signal changes to alcohol stimuli compared to matched nonabusers in limbic and frontal regions.
